4f74f84e3956da24.source:
(value) =>
    isHttpUrl(value) ? true : "Pull request URL must be a well-formed HTTP(S) URL."

0b8ed7bac8b5f0db.source:
(value) =>
      hasOnlyPairedSurrogates(value)
        ? true
        : "clientRequestId must contain valid paired Unicode surrogates."

31e57149c0b88ed7.source:
(input) =>
        !(input.tabId !== undefined && input.reuseExistingTab === false) ||
        "tabId cannot be combined with reuseExistingTab=false."

62f5a93a0f08b95d.source:
(input) =>
        Number(input.url !== undefined) + Number(input.target !== undefined) === 1 ||
        "Provide exactly one of url or target."

21ac5f0442b289fe.source:
(input) =>
        !(input.selector !== undefined && input.locator !== undefined) ||
        "Provide at most one of selector or locator."

89c49dac99285426.source:
(input) =>
        Number(input.selector !== undefined) + Number(input.locator !== undefined) === 1 ||
        "Provide exactly one of selector or locator."

21891774abfb8b35.source: (id) => id !== "local" || "The local host id is reserved."

f0abab71e3b687de.source:
(hosts) =>
      new Set(hosts.map((host) => host.id)).size === hosts.length ||
      "Device host ids must be unique."

d47c6f04fdc3cb77.source:
({ width, height }                                                     ) =>
    width * height <= PREVIEW_VIEWPORT_MAX_AREA ||
    `Viewport area must not exceed ${PREVIEW_VIEWPORT_MAX_AREA} pixels.`

fe592ca0722cf7ea.source:
(update) =>
      update.autoResume !== undefined ||
      update.snooze !== undefined ||
      "A recovery update must include autoResume or snooze."

9d17f3fe6e0abee4.source: (kind        ) => !knownKinds.has(kind) || "A known kind must decode in full."
